points.name: floor_a
points.help: A point on the floor surface nearer the lead foot, on a visible straight floor edge or mat edge. floor_a and floor_b together give the floor line.

points.name: floor_b
points.help: A point on the floor surface nearer the trail foot, on a visible straight floor edge or mat edge. floor_a and floor_b together give the floor line.
